purpose: Manage Loyalty panel explaining that unattended low-loyalty Mates risk Slacking (50% expertise reduction) and Mutiny, with options to pay gold or gems to restore loyalty to 100 or 110
full_text: If Mates with low Loyalty are unattended, it will increase the chance of Slacking to occur. Mates who are Slacking will have 50% Reduction to their expertise, and may cause Mutiny. Recover Loyalty to 100 [Regular Pay] Recover Loyalty to 110 [Special Pay]
